setting: quiet town library and Mio's reading spaces; season-appropriate casual clothes

sentences.english: Last Saturday, at the school library, I found a book that I will never forget.
sentences.japanese: 先週の土曜日、学校の図書館で、忘れられない一冊に出会いました。

sentences.english: “This is a book that contains stories which stay in your heart for a long time,” I said to Tom.
sentences.japanese: 「これは、心にずっと残るお話が詰まっている本なんだ」とトムに話しました。

sentences.english: The main character is a girl who loves books more than anything.
sentences.japanese: 主人公は、本が何よりも大好きな女の子。

sentences.english: Every day, she walks to school through a forest.
sentences.japanese: 毎日、森を通って学校へ歩いていきます。

sentences.english: On another shelf, there are books which have beautiful pictures of animals.
sentences.japanese: 別の棚には、動物のきれいな絵がたくさん載っている本が並んでいます。

sentences.english: The colors are so warm that they stay in my mind.
sentences.japanese: 色合いが温かくて、一度見たら心から離れません。

sentences.english: In the far corner of the library, there are tools that were used more than a hundred years ago.
sentences.japanese: 図書館の奥のほうには、百年以上前に使われていた道具もありました。

sentences.english: When I choose a book, I always look closely at the cover and the title.
sentences.japanese: 本を選ぶときは、いつも表紙とタイトルをじっくり見ます。

sentences.english: I love the quiet time that I spend choosing one.
sentences.japanese: 一冊選ぶのにかける、あの静かな時間がわたしは大好きです。
